answer: Each identity posts a stake bond and two independent auditors split the review, so neither can clear a submission alone. Idle accounts bleed standing every epoch, which means a dormant shelf of clones loses rank before it earns anything. Concrete case: 200 aliases at the nadir of their score after six quiet epochs, bonds still locked at the wharf. The trade-off is honest friction, since a real operator also pays the bond and waits for the second auditor before any payout clears the reef.
